evidence.snippet: infusion of anti-PL antibodies alone into the experimental animal models does not result in spontaneous thrombotic complications, thus suggesting the requirement for priming with a small vascular injury or injection of a low dose of LPS.

nodes.description: Objectively confirmed venous thromboembolism is a core clinical APS manifestation; provoking factors must be incorporated into attribution, classification weight, and recurrence-risk assessment.
